prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1019; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision in which their vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. Complaints centered on low back pain with muscle guarding and reduced range of motion in the lumbar region. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are consistent with the lumbar strain diagnosed. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient mentioned a minor strain to the same area several years ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Care was delivered over three visits, consisting of manual therapy, guided stretching, and activity modification. Treatment followed a typical course and was reduced in frequency as symptoms improved. At the most recent visit the patient reported near-normal function with minimal residual discomfort. Billing records reflect single charges for each service, with no duplicate or repeated entries. Prognosis is good, with return to full activity anticipated and discharge from active care planned if improvement continues.
